displayDescription: First-person camcorder walk through a repeating corridor that slows at the only lit door, where one idea node links into a system.
styleRenderer: Three.js 0.187.0 (WebGLRenderer, MeshBasicMaterial baked canvas textures, Fog)
audioDescription: Silent preview — no music, sound effects or narration.
limitations: Procedural illustrative corridor; indirect light is baked into canvas textures and fog, not physically simulated.
Camcorder look is approximated with a DOM overlay and vignette; no tape noise or exposure effects, to keep text and anomaly clean.
Three.js bundled from the existing local node_modules via esbuild (no installs); creative_pool select_project_technologies failed because PROJECT_DEPENDENCIES.json is absent.
No preview recipes or BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json supplied; the core Motion Graphic action is demonstrated.
Blender intentionally not used per instruction.
